headline.en: Postdoctoral Research Associate at King's College London
headline.zh: 伦敦国王学院博士后研究员

summary.en: Computer vision and multimodal learning researcher with six publications, five as first author, and experience spanning medical imaging AI, crowd counting, multi-view multimodal driver monitoring, and industry collaboration.
summary.zh: 从事计算机视觉与多模态学习研究，已发表 6 篇论文，其中 5 篇为第一作者；研究经历涵盖医学影像 AI、人群计数、多视角多模态驾驶员监控及产业合作。

bullets.en: Develop AI-driven precision active-surveillance tools for prostate cancer, spanning patient selection, risk stratification, lesion detection, progression assessment, and personalised surveillance.
bullets.zh: 面向前列腺癌主动监测，研发 AI 驱动的精准决策工具，覆盖患者筛选、风险分层、病灶检测、进展评估与个体化随访。

bullets.en: Build patient-specific Multi-Modal Fingerprints that integrate longitudinal prostate MRI, clinicopathological variables, demographic data, and radiology reports.
bullets.zh: 构建患者级多模态指纹（MMF），融合纵向前列腺 MRI、临床病理变量、人口统计信息与放射学报告。

bullets.en: Investigate foundation models, self-supervised and semi-supervised learning, and longitudinal architectures, with emphasis on missing data, domain shift, and external validation.
bullets.zh: 研究基础模型、自监督与半监督学习以及纵向建模，重点处理数据缺失、域偏移与外部验证问题。

bullets.en: Contribute to clinician-facing standardised reports that translate model outputs into patient selection and follow-up decisions.
bullets.zh: 参与生成面向临床的标准化报告，将模型输出转化为患者筛选和随访决策支持。

bullets.en: Refined and extended DAD annotations with nine non-driving activities and prepared data for robust benchmarking.
bullets.zh: 整理并扩展 DAD 数据集标注，新增 9 类非驾驶活动，为稳健性评测准备数据。

bullets.en: Designed a multi-view multimodal driver-monitoring system using masked multi-head self-attention, improving DAD AUC-ROC from 88% to 97% and increasing robustness to missing views or modalities.
bullets.zh: 设计基于掩码多头自注意力的多视角多模态驾驶员监控系统，将 DAD 上的 AUC-ROC 从 88% 提升至 97%，并增强视角或模态缺失时的稳健性。

bullets.en: Led labs and tutorials for an undergraduate Python and introductory machine-learning module, covering regression, classification, and neural networks.
bullets.zh: 承担本科 Python 与机器学习导论课程的实验课和辅导课，内容涵盖回归、分类与神经网络。

bullets.en: Provided one-to-one and small-group support for programming, machine-learning concepts, code troubleshooting, and experiment design.
bullets.zh: 为学生提供一对一及小组辅导，讲解编程与机器学习概念，并协助排查代码和实验设计问题。

detail.en: Supervisors: Prof. Victor Sanchez and Dr Tanaya Guha.
detail.zh: 导师：Victor Sanchez 教授、Tanaya Guha 博士。

detail.en: Research on guide-dog oestrus-interval prediction and digital twins of urban crowds.
detail.zh: 研究课题包括导盲犬动情周期间隔预测与城市人群数字孪生。

degree.en: BSc in Mathematics and Applied Mathematics

institution.en: Southern University of Science and Technology

service.en: Reviewer for IEEE TNNLS, IEEE TMM, IEEE SPL, ECCV, ACM MM, CVPRW, ICME, WACV, BMVC, and ICIP.
service.zh: 担任 IEEE TNNLS、IEEE TMM、IEEE SPL、ECCV、ACM MM、CVPRW、ICME、WACV、BMVC 与 ICIP 审稿人。

value.en: Attention, vision transformers, prompt tuning, CLIP, contrastive learning, multimodal alignment, multimodal fusion
value.zh: 注意力机制、视觉 Transformer、提示调优、CLIP、对比学习、多模态对齐、多模态融合

value.en: PyTorch, TIMM, OpenCLIP, Transformers, TensorBoard, Optuna
NumPy, SciPy, scikit-learn, pandas, OpenCV, Matplotlib, Seaborn

Probability, statistical inference, optimisation, stochastic processes, time-series modelling, survival analysis, computational statistics, real, complex, functional and Fourier analysis, measure theory
value.zh: 概率论、统计推断、优化、随机过程、时间序列建模、生存分析、计算统计、实分析、复分析、泛函分析、傅里叶分析、测度论

value.en: SSH, Git, Linux, LaTeX, Markdown, Microsoft Word
